scope: Complete supplied three-page main, four source figures and bibliography entries 1–18 read. SI and cited full texts unreviewed.

bibliographic_scope.title: Synthesis and Characterization of Nanocrystalline Bismuth Telluride
bibliographic_scope.authors: Edward E. Foos; Rhonda M. Stroud; Alan D. Berry

reagent_and_stock_context.bismuth: Aldrich bismuth(III) perchlorate oxide hydrate; hydrate x unknown. Purchased solid and AOT conditioned overnight92°C, then N2 glovebag. The later0.83M BiOClO4 solution has no stated preparation/solvent partition.
reagent_and_stock_context.AOT: Aldrich sodium dioctylsulfosuccinate; named surfactant, no aggregate model.
reagent_and_stock_context.TOP: Aldrich, vacuum distilled, stored in glovebox.
reagent_and_stock_context.liquids: Triply distilled water, absolute ethanol, reagent-grade toluene/hexane; N2 purge and5 freeze–pump–thaw cycles. Parenthetical500mL in this conditioning sentence is not assigned as individual reaction volume.
reagent_and_stock_context.telluride: (Me3Si)2Te prepared fromLi2Te andMe3SiCl via external reference16; that source is unreviewed. Diluted in hexane vacuum-distilled from sodium benzophenone. No upstream quantities/schedule invented.
reagent_and_stock_context.w: [H2O]/[AOT] molar ratio; stock-water contribution and exact water charges unreported.
reagent_and_stock_context.typical_vessel: 500mL flask; no additional neck/heater configuration reported.

source_interpretation.text: The source compares unannealed w = 3 and w = 5 powders and reports mean TEM sizes of4.5 and7.4nm, respectively. It attributes the larger size to greater water/AOT ratio. Exact w = 3 precursor and water charges are missing, so the result is not converted into a complete alternative charge recipe.

evidence.locator: Main PDF p. 2–3, Figures3–4 and size discussion

source_interpretation.text: For one comparison batch, elemental C/H falls from9.26/1.69wt% after one toluene wash to3.93/0.72wt% after toluene/methanol washing. FTIR supports removal of AOT. The typical preparation instead uses repeated sonication with toluene, ethanol and hexane, followed by TOP treatment; those sequences remain distinct. C/H is not a quantitative ligand coverage.

evidence.locator: Main PDF p. 2, Washing discussion and Figure1

source_interpretation.text: Two dropwise reactions yield elemental-analysis ratios Bi1.00Te0.95 andBi1.00Te1.10, distinct from the intended Bi2Te3 composition. Their water/AOT ratios, exact feed quantities and structures are unreported. They do not inherit the microscopy or phase figures of the rapid-addition powders.

Annealing w = 5 powder at230°C for4h underHe sharpens its diffraction peaks. Both unannealed and annealed patterns agree with commercial Bi2Te3 reference powder. No annealed particle-size number or refined atom coordinates are supplied.

evidence.locator: Main PDF p. 2, Figure2 and XRD discussion

source_interpretation.topic: Small TEM counts limit the conclusion
source_interpretation.text: Agglomeration prevents an accurate particle-size distribution. The reported means use21particles forw = 3 and28forw = 5, with estimated mean-size uncertainty strictly<10%. This is not a polydispersity value or normal-distribution standard deviation.

The introduction discusses quantum-confinement predictions and earlier thermoelectric systems. The present paper supplies synthesis, elemental analysis, diffraction and microscopy; measuring quantum-confinement effects on thermoelectric properties is left to future work. No current Seebeck coefficient, conductivity or thermoelectric figure of merit is assigned.

evidence.locator: Main PDF p. 1,3, Introduction and Summary

source_interpretation.topic: Air handling and external oxidation evidence
source_interpretation.text: Presence-versus-absence-of-air experiments show no observable differences at the reported stage. The oxidation/XPS observation is attributed to external reference17, not a current-study XPS panel or evidence of indefinite air stability.
